column3: Nami couldn't say two words, for eight years.
She was buying her village back from a pirate, alone. She wouldn't ask anyone, because she believed it would get people killed.
Then she finally said it. Luffy. Help me. And he never even asked why.
Real people are more like that than we expect. In one study, students guessed they'd have to ask about twenty strangers, to get five surveys filled in. It took about ten.
The no you're afraid of is mostly in your head.
